description: This file defines core interfaces and a Color class used in a graphing or visualization engine, including non-copyable and non-movable base structs, expression and variable interfaces, and a Color class with RGBA components.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: Represents an RGBA color with methods for construction and conversion to/from a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: Color(uint8_t r, uint8_t g, uint8_t b)
methods.description: Constructor initializing color with RGB components and default alpha to 255.

methods.name: Color()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing color to black with full opacity.

methods.description: Constructor initializing color from a 32-bit integer value.

methods.name: operator uint32_t() const
methods.description: Converts the Color object to a 32-bit integer in RGBA format.
